title: Get started with ccldr
text: Use ccld_verify() vector data-frame column possible license numbers. CCLD API expects facility numbers 9-digit form, ccld_verify() accepts 8- 9-digit inputs pads internally making requests. returns one row per input, including unknown licenses. Example output: Keeping found = FALSE rows result makes audits easier: original records stay visible instead disappearing join.
code: library(ccldr) library(dplyr) library(readr)  rr <- read_csv("rr_sites.csv")  verified <- ccld_verify(rr$license_number)  rr |>   left_join(verified, by = c("license_number" = "input")) |>   select(site_name, license_number, found, facility_name, status) #> # A tibble: 2 x 5 #>   site_name                 license_number found facility_name       status #>   <chr>                     <chr>          <lgl> <chr>               <chr> #> 1 Johnson Family Child Care 13423996       TRUE  JOHNSON III, JOHNNY Licensed #> 2 Unknown Site              99999999       FALSE <NA>                <NA>

title: Get started with ccldr
text: Use ccld_facility() need full API record one known license. Like ccld_verify(), accepts either 8- 9-digit license form. result one-row tibble scalar facility fields nested list-columns reports complaints. Example output: Example output: Example output: ccld_facility() scalar design. column candidate licenses, run ccld_verify() first request full detail facilities need.
code: facility <- ccld_facility("13423996")  facility |>   select(facility_name, status, capacity, last_visit_date) #> # A tibble: 1 x 4 #>   facility_name       status   capacity last_visit_date #>   <chr>               <chr>       <int> <date> #> 1 JOHNSON III, JOHNNY Licensed       14 2024-11-04 facility |>   tidyr::unnest(reports) |>   select(facility_number, report_date, report_type) #> # A tibble: 1 x 3 #>   facility_number report_date report_type #>   <chr>           <date>      <chr> #> 1 013423996       2024-11-04  Other facility |>   tidyr::unnest(complaints) #> # A tibble: 0 x 4 #> # i 4 variables: facility_number <chr>, complaint_date <date>, #> #   allegation <chr>, outcome <chr>

title: Get started with ccldr
text: Use ccld_alameda() need current set Alameda County facilities supported child-care type. Example output: Supported values : "large_fccs" "infant_centers" "school_age_centers" "preschools" "single_licensed_centers" "small_fccs" supported API blocks search route. "centers" supported API bucket sparse legacy; use "preschools" center workflow.
code: preschools <- ccld_alameda("preschools") large_fccs <- ccld_alameda("large_fccs")  preschools |>   select(facility_number, facility_name, status, city, zip) |>   slice_head(n = 3) #> # A tibble: 3 x 5 #>   facility_number facility_name          status   city    zip #>   <chr>           <chr>                  <chr>    <chr>   <chr> #> 1 013423751       WILD CHILD SCHOOLHOUSE Licensed Oakland 94611 #> 2 013423056       AGAPE LEARNING CENTER  Licensed Oakland 94621 #> 3 013422467       COLIBRI PRESCHOOL      Licensed Oakland 94611

title: Get started with ccldr
text: Use ccld_add_census_geographies() need coordinates Census geography identifiers facility rows addresses. helper uses U.S. Census Geocoder, require API key, deduplicates repeated addresses, caches responses disk. Example output:
code: preschools_geo <- preschools |>   ccld_add_census_geographies()  preschools_geo |>   select(     facility_number,     geocode_status,     latitude,     longitude,     census_tract_geoid,     census_block_geoid,     zcta_geoid,     unified_school_district_name   ) |>   slice_head(n = 3) #> # A tibble: 3 x 8 #>   facility_number geocode_status latitude longitude census_tract_geoid #>   <chr>           <chr>             <dbl>     <dbl> <chr> #> 1 013423751       matched            37.8     -122. 06001401100 #> 2 013423056       matched            37.7     -122. 06001409400 #> 3 013422467       matched            37.8     -122. 06001401100 #> # i 3 more variables: census_block_geoid <chr>, zcta_geoid <chr>, #> #   unified_school_district_name <chr>

what: Why did my license become 9 digits?
title: Troubleshooting and FAQ
text: CCLD’s Transparency API expects facility numbers 9-digit form. Many public local data files store number 8 digits. ccld_pad() adds leading zero requests use API’s canonical form.

what: Why does ccld_verify() return found = FALSE?
title: Troubleshooting and FAQ
text: ccld_verify() keeps every input row. API return facility detail license, row stays result found = FALSE missing facility fields. makes failed matches visible joins.

title: Troubleshooting and FAQ
text: License inputs must contain digits must 9 digits fewer. Values "ABC123" "0123456789" rejected ccldr_invalid_input error.

title: Troubleshooting and FAQ
text: ccld_alameda() intentionally supports API routes return useful data: "small_fccs" blocked API route used Transparency search. "centers" maps sparse legacy API bucket. small FCC enumeration, use CKAN snapshot chekos/ccld-open-data-snapshot. center workflows, use "preschools".

what: What does the 250-result cap warning mean?
title: Troubleshooting and FAQ
text: CCLD search endpoint can cap individual responses 250 records. reduce risk, ccld_alameda() queries Alameda city separately. city still reports 250 results, function warns additional facilities may hidden API response cap.

title: R Client for the CCLD Transparency API
text: ccldr talks public APIs. reproducible scripts, keep habits mind: Use cache = FALSE need fresh API response single call. Use ccld_cache_clear() rerunning full workflow scratch. Use options(ccldr.verbose = TRUE) print request paths debugging. Use options(ccldr.delay = 1) slow batch requests. ccld_alameda() walks 17 Alameda cities avoid API’s 250-result response cap. city still hits cap, function warns snapshot may incomplete. ccld_add_census_geographies() calls U.S. Census Geocoder per distinct address, requests layers = "" default, keeps unmatched rows output geocode_status explaining happened.

title: Add Census geographies to CCLD facility rows — ccld_add_census_geographies
text: data data frame containing facility address columns. address_col Name street address column. Defaults "street_address". city_col Name city column. Defaults "city". state_col Optional name state column. NULL, missing, blank, default_state used. zip_col Name ZIP code column. Defaults "zip". default_state State abbreviation used state_col absent blank. Defaults "CA". benchmark Census Geocoder benchmark. Defaults "Public_AR_Current". vintage Census Geocoder vintage. Defaults "Current_Current". layers Census geography layers request. Defaults "" ZCTA school district layers included available. cache Logical value (default TRUE) controlling whether -disk response cache used.
